preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= n <= 4*10**5 and 0 <= m <= 4*10**5
preconditions.description: For each test case, number of vertices is between 1 and 400,000 and number of edges is between 0 and 400,000.

preconditions.expression: for each edge: 1 <= a_i, b_i <= n
preconditions.description: Each edge connects vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: len(output_line) == n
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: for each value in output_line: value in {-1, 0, 1, 2}
postconditions.description: Each value in the output line is one of {-1, 0, 1, 2}.
